title: Molekane yo o neng a fapoga
intro: O tloga o ribolola kgang ya mowa o o neng o tshela mo moriting wa boporofeti mme le fa go ntse jalo o tlhopha tsela e e neng e isa kwa tshenyegong. Palo eno e ne e nna le legae le mongwe wa barongwa ba ba tlhophilweng ba ga Allah mme ya palelwa ke go tlhatlhobiwa tumelo. Molekane yo o latlhegileng yono ke mang?
clues: Ke ne ke tshela mo gare ga batho ba ba neng ba gana pitso ya tshiamo, mme ke ne ke sa ba ganetse.
Ke ne ke nyetse moporofeti wa ga Allah, mme ke ne ke sa dumele mo tumelong eo.
Fa barongwa ba ne ba tla kwa legaeng la me ka tlhagiso, ga ke a ka ka ba dumela.
Molekane wa me o ne a laelwa go tswa mo motseng le badumedi, mme ke ne ke se mo gare ga bone.
Kotlhao e ne ya fologela mo bathong ba gaetsho, mme nna ka nyelediwa mmogo le bone.
Ke umakiwa mo Quran jaaka sekai sa go sa dumele, go bapa le mosadi wa ga Nuh, mo Surah At-Tahrim.

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: O oka monna wa gagwe ka go sa dumele
O ganne molaetsa wa ga Moporofeti Hud
O ne a obamela medingwana phatlalatsa kwa Kaaba
O loga leano kgatlhanong le thomo ya monna wa gagwe
O ne a gana go amogela boporofeti jwa ga morwawe
trial.answer: O oka monna wa gagwe ka go sa dumele

outcome.label: Botso
options: O bolokilwe le monna wa gagwe
Go isiwa botshwarwa kwa lefatsheng le le kgakala
Ke ne ka nna modumedi moragonyana

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
